english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person or behaviour that is hostile or liable to attack.
Use this when hostile specifically means aggressive or likely to attack.

examples.english: They become very aggressive when they get drunk.
examples.traditional: 佢一飲醉就好有攻擊性。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 jam2 zeoi3 zau6 hou2 jau5 gung1 gik1 sing3

examples.english: This dog gets very hostile when it sees strangers.
examples.traditional: 呢隻狗見到陌生人就好有攻擊性。
